title: TRAIN trust-list desired state (contracts v1)
description: What one trust framework's TRAIN trust list is to contain, as the repository declares it: the zones that claim the framework and the issuers the framework trusts. The file is changed by pull request and applied to the TSPA by scripts/train-trust-list/reconcile.sh, which writes only the difference and proves every write by reading the list back. Entries the reconciler writes carry a managed-by marker; entries without it (the pipeline's measurement entries, the client's own) are never touched.

framework.description: The trust framework whose list this file governs; the path segment of the TSPA's /{fw}/trust-list. The list itself is created once at federation setup, never by the reconciler.

operator.description: Who operates the framework, for the human reading the entries (TSPInformationURI stays n/a unless an issuer names one).

zones.description: The DNS zones that claim this framework: each gets a PTR record _scheme._trust.<domain> pointing at the framework, written by the TSPA through the zone manager when the reconciler runs with --with-zones. Nothing in the trust list itself changes for a zone.

name.description: The zone's short name in this repository (the zone a release is deployed to).

domain.description: The DNS name under which the zone claims the framework.

issuers.description: The issuers the framework trusts, one entry each in the trust list. Removing one here removes its entry on the next apply; a verifier that cached the list keeps trusting it for the window docs/train-trust-lists.md documents.

id.description: Stable identifier of the issuer in this file; the entry's UUID is derived from the framework and this id, so renaming an issuer is a removal and a creation.

name.description: The issuer's name as the entry shows it (TSPName).

serviceTypeIdentifier.description: The string a verifier presents as issuer to the TCR, which matches it against TSPServices.TSPService[].ServiceTypeIdentifier (ADR-0011 4.3). For a credential issuer this is its DID. Unique across the file, and across the live list.

did.description: The DID written to ServiceDigitalIdentity.DigitalId.DID (informational for the TCR); defaults to serviceTypeIdentifier.

serviceName.description: ServiceName of the entry's one service.

credentialTypes.description: The credential types the issuer issues (ServiceIssuedCredentialTypes).

supplyPoint.description: Where the issuer's service is reached (ServiceSupplyPoint); n/a when absent.

informationUri.description: Where a human reads about the issuer (TSPInformationURI); n/a when absent.

zone.description: The zone the issuer belongs to, when it belongs to one declared above; recorded in the entry's identifier list.

status.description: ServiceCurrentStatus. A suspended issuer stays in the list, marked; removing it from the file removes the entry.
